title: Black bean dal with spices
summary: Black bean dal with spices is a indian dinner built around canned black beans and onions, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Black bean dal with spices. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add canned black beans and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and onions.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until garlic is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Black bean dal with spices before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Black bean dal with spices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
